description: Israeli soldiers and military vehicles stormed the campus with more than 8,000 students present, smashing the main gate and firing across campus. Over forty people, mostly students, were injured. Sources said the raid followed a student solidarity event for Palestinian prisoners.
energy_note: Eight thousand students, and grenades on the lawn.

aspect: The UN's characterisation and the numbers
description: UN experts said the assault on Birzeit is 'not episodic violence but a systematic policy', reporting 463 university students detained - 148 of them from Birzeit - plus 27 higher education staff, most under administrative detention. 'The purpose is disruption.'
energy_note: Four hundred and sixty-three students, in custody.

description: The Palestinian Prisoner's Society described the arrest of four female Birzeit students in overnight raids across Ramallah as reflecting a longstanding policy targeting university students, particularly women.
energy_note: Arrested at 3am for being a student.

aspect: Families are not told the charges
description: It is common for families and institutions to receive little information regarding the charges, so a household loses a daughter to a system that does not explain what she is accused of.
energy_note: Gone, and nobody will say what for.

aspect: The degree takes longer, and that costs money
description: Raids, closures, detentions and rescheduled exams extend a three-year degree by semesters. Each added semester is fees, rent, and a year of earnings not started.
energy_note: A degree that keeps getting longer.
